notes.title: Important update
notes.notes:
[h2]Fix bug level 11 [/h2]
[list]
[*] Some [b]essential key parts[/b] were disappearing if linear rotation is used.
[*] The text of Secret File #3 was incorrect.
[/list]

All these bugs are now fixed.
Sorry for that...

[/list]

notes.title: Content and features update
notes.notes:
Lot of improvement in this update! 
[list]
[*] New gameplay on levels (Temple, Base, volcano)
[*] Fighting crabüls are less easy,
[*] Fixed issues when you restart level, 
[*] Fixed linear rotation issues,
[*] Fixed the dialog bug (mouth movement and sound)
[*] Ability to delete all gameplay datas from the start menu > options
[*] ... and some minors corrections
[/list]
We hope you'll enjoy !
